alternatives_and_negative_results: Do not patch the DUT to compensate for a measurement/collection bug, and do not use aggregate metrics with a missing row.
applicability: Stagewise RTL capture, debug readback and golden-vector comparison.
assessed_root_cause: The fault was in diagnostic collection scope, not the FFT arithmetic output.
author_role: historical project engineering record, backfilled by FPGA engineering copilot
chosen_corrective_method: Assert expected shape and full index coverage before calculating stage metrics; keep the original historical diagnostic and corrected adapter separately versioned.
generalizable_lesson: Verification infrastructure has its own correctness contract: dimensions, indices and coverage must be checked before interpreting numerical differences.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: An array-shape mismatch could be misdiagnosed as a DUT arithmetic defect, or incomplete diagnostics could be accepted because final outputs looked correct.
non_applicability: Does not excuse genuine DUT mismatches or permit partial stage coverage.
observable_consequence: C04 comparison exposed 127-versus-128 row mismatch; the derived capture adapter moved initialization outside the range loop and all 128 range rows across five FFT stages were checked.
observed_problem: A historical diagnostic adapter reinitialized its FFT stage capture list inside the range loop, omitting range row 0 for FFT1-FFT4 metrics.
repeatable_validation: For each stage, assert 128 range rows x32 bins and compare all integer components against independent golden outputs.
reviewer_role: documentary evidence validation by FPGA engineering copilot; not a separate human reviewer
safety_contract_constraints: Preserve original v0.5/v0.6 evidence and only correct derived capture tooling; do not alter the numeric baseline.
title: Verify stage-capture dimensions independently from arithmetic correctness
